english:
Intrinsic to Dreaming City Armor. Permanently removed if replaced.

Increases Ability and Weapon Damage by 5%|10%|15%|20%|25% and damage you take by 3%|6%|9%|12%|15% with 1|2|3|4|5 mods equipped while in the Dreaming City.
